findings.finding: SE Stage4 gate uses mdot_SE_stage4_in_kgps mapped to V4_hot_inlet immediately downstream of the Stage4 piston pressure source; it is not a bed outlet signal.
findings.implication: Bed residence time cannot by itself waive the inlet tracking gate.

findings.finding: SE Stage4 target and Stage4 integrator enable require active valve columns and nonzero pressure bias above the active floor; commutation holds pressure bias at the zero switch pressure until the final ramp.
findings.implication: New-valve opening precedes effective target/PI activation, creating a causal dead-time candidate.

findings.finding: The 0.30 s settled guard, 15% pointwise limit, 5% RMS limit, and final-cycle window shifts were checked together.
findings.implication: No evidence supports relaxing the instantaneous gate or replacing it with integrated mass error.
